name: Cabo Verde Nationals 2026

venue.name: [UniCV](https://unicv.edu.cv/)
venue.address: Campus do Palmarejo Grande, Praia Santiago CV, 7943-010, Cabo Verde

information:
First official WCA competition in Cabo Verde.

The fastest competitor from Cabo Verde in 3x3 event will be crowned national champion of Cabo Verde.

Everyone can participate, but only people with Cabo Verde nationality can win prizes and honours.

Three spots in the 3x3 final will be reserved for participants with Cabo Verde nationality.
